requirement.summary: Gen Sales Export v2 - need to add user department fields to the CHECKS file
requirement.description:
Add new fields to Check level file.

Open Employee user department code

Suggested Field Name - FEMPUSERDEPTID

Value - Open check employee user department code

Cashier user department code

Suggested Field Name - FCASHUSERDEPTID

Value - Cashier user department code
requirement.refinement_notes:
HERO-68955 General Sales Export V2 - Add user department fields
to Check file

file)

knowledge_base.content: CUS083 - Sales Summary Report Report Information Field Value Name Sales Summary Report Code CUS083 Parameters to Validate Parameters Name Description Options Default Date Type (single-select) Select Current Business Day shows current business day data; Last Business Day shows last business day data; Specified As Below shows specified date data. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Query Configuration: Maximum Query Days, Default: Empty, No Limit Current Business Day, Last Business Day, Specified as Below Current Business Day Shops (multi-select) Select all shops shows all shops data; single shop shows single shop data; multiple shops shows multiple shops data. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No All, Single, Multiple All Outlet Groups (multi-select) Select all outlet groups shows all outlet groups data; single outlet group shows single outlet group data; multiple outlet groups shows multiple outlet groups data All, Single, Multiple All Outlets (multi-select) Select all outlets shows all outlets data; single outlet shows single outlet data; multiple outlets shows multiple outlets data All, Single, Multiple All Data Fields to Validate Fields Name Fields Description Field Calculation Report Title Shows corresponding report title by selection of parameters: report name "Sales Summary Report"; if pick up a single shop, show shop name else hide; if pick up a single outlet, show outlet name else hide; show picked business date - Shop Shop name. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No - Outlet Group Outlet group name - Outlets Outlet name - Payment Method Dynamic field showing payment method name; the value shows payment total for each payment method. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Payment Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit - Total Sales Sum amount of all payment methods for the outlet. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Sum Of All Payment Methods For The Outlet Cover Guest number - Department Group Dynamic field showing department group name: Food, Beverage, Takeaway Food, Takeaway Beverage, Tob., Misc., Others (Catering); the value dynamically displays the net sales amount of item department group code from HKJCRPT001 to HKJCRPT007. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Department Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit - Service Charge Add-on service charge. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Add On Service Charge Rnd Rounding amount. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Rounding Amount Catering Total Dynamically displays the net sales total of catering departments plus service charge; catering departments are item department group codes from HKJCRPT001 to HKJCRPT007. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Catering Departments Net Sales Amount (HKJCRPT001 - HKJCRPT007) + Service Charge Non Catering Dynamic field showing department group name: Non Catering; the value dynamically displays the net sales amount of item department group code HKJCRPT008. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Net Sales Amount Of Item Department Group Code HKJCRPT008 Catering & Non Catering Total Value of column "Catering Total" + "Non Catering". Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Catering Total + Non Catering Food Average Average "Food" net sales per cover. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Food / Cover F&B Average Average "Food+Beverage" net sales per cover. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . (Food + Beverage) / Cover Total Sales (Outlet Group) Summarize the amount of each column for the outlet group. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Sum Of Each Column For The Outlet Group Grand Total Summarize the amount of each column for all outlet groups. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Sum Of Each Column For All Outlet Groups ** END OF REPORT ** Standard end-of-report marker - Printed At Time Print time of the report. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Date Format, Default Date Format: CCYY-MM-DD; Time Format, Default Time Format: 24-hour clock - Printed By User User who printed/exported the report - Report Code Report number CUS083 visible in every report and export; can be configured via System Management > System Configuration > Report Module > Show Footer Report Code: Yes = show, No = hide - Page Number Page number of the report - Requirements Traceability Fix Version JIRA Ticket - HERO-18675 - HERO-27563

knowledge_base.content: POS002 - Hourly Sales Report Report Information Field Value Name Hourly Sales Report Code POS002 Parameters to Validate Parameters Name Description Options Default Platform Setting/Notes Date Type Select the business day scope (single-select). Specified day is enabled when 'Specified As Below' is selected Current Business Day, Last Business Day, Specified As Below Current Business Day Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Query Configuration: Maximum Query Days, Default: Empty, No Limit Day Of Week Date exclusions - select weekday(s) to exclude from the query result (multi-select); unselected shows all All, Single, Multiple All - Specified Date Date exclusions - exclude specified date(s), format YYYY-MM-DD, multiple dates supported (e.g. 2018-08-08, 2018-08-09) - 1900-01-01 - Day Of Month Date exclusions - select day(s) of month to exclude (multi-select, e.g. 1, 10); null shows all All, Single, Multiple All - Shops Filter data by shop(s) (multi-select) All, Single, Multiple All Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No Outlets Filter data by outlet(s) under the selected shop(s) (multi-select) All, Single, Multiple All Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No Time Interval Select the period interval of the report (single-select) 30 Minutes, 1 Hour, Specified As Below 1 Hour - Time Interval (Minutes) Custom interval in minutes, enabled when Time Interval = 'Specified As Below'; valid range 60~720 minutes; if the value is not a number, a decimal, or less than 60 minutes, the default 60 minutes is used - - - Revenue/Non-Revenue Filter data by revenue type (single-select) Revenue, Non-Revenue, Revenue + Non-Revenue, Advance Order QA没有标准,请PO提供方案 - Attributes Condition Logic condition between selected attribute keys (single-select): And = checks include all selected attributes; Or = checks include any selected attribute And, Or QA没有标准,请PO提供方案 - Attribute Key 1~10 Filter data by check attribute key(s) (multi-select) All, Single, Multiple All - Data Fields to Validate Report Header And Footer Fields Name Fields Description Field Calculation Platform Setting/Notes Report Title Show corresponding report title by selection [Shop Name / Report Name / Outlet Name / Business Day / Item Group]: show report name "Hourly Sales Report"; show shop name only when a single shop is selected; show outlet name only when a single outlet is selected - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No Attributes Condition Show the selected attribute logic condition (And/Or) - - Attributes Type Show selected attribute option name(s), separated by ","; if one or more names are selected they are displayed normally; if All is selected it is not displayed - - Printed At Time Show running report date and time, format follows the platform settings - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Date Format, Default Date Format: CCYY-MM-DD; Time Format, Default Time Format: 24-hour clock Printed By User Show running report user last name and first name - - Report Number Show report number in the footer of all report/export; System Configuration > Report Module > Show Footer Report Code = Yes/No - - P. Show page number - - Hourly Sales Table Fields Name Fields Description Field Calculation Platform Setting/Notes Outlet Show outlet name; data is broken down by outlet - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No Period Show check paid time; when Time Interval (60~720 Minutes) = xx, periods start from 0 with an interval of xx minutes - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Time Format, Default Time Format: 24-hour clock Checks Count Show checks count of the period - - Guests Show guests count of the period - - Gross Sales Show check gross sales amount Gross Sales = Net Sales - Discount Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Net Sales Show check net sales (total) amount - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Sales/Check Show average net sales per check Net Sales / Checks Count Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Sub Total Show subtotal of each outlet for Checks Count, Guests, Gross Sales, Net Sales, Sales/Check and Sales/Guest - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Grand Total Show the sum of all outlets for each field (Checks Count, Guests, Gross Sales, Net Sales, Sales/Check, Sales/Guest) - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . knowledge_base.content: POS220 - Sales Report(By Category) Report Information Field Value Name Sales Report(By Category) Code POS220 Parameters to Validate Parameters Name Description Options Default Platform Setting/Notes Date Type Select the month scope of the report (single-select); Current Month/Last Month display the selected month and the next three months; Specific Month displays up to 4 months of data counting from the beginning month Current Month, Last Month, Specific Month QA没有标准,请PO提供方案 Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Query Configuration: Maximum Query Days, Default: Empty, No Limit Begin Month Start month of the specified month range; enabled when Date Type = 'Specific Month' - - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Query Configuration: Maximum Query Days, Default: Empty, No Limit End Month End month of the specified month range; enabled when Date Type = 'Specific Month' - - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Query Configuration: Maximum Query Days, Default: Empty, No Limit Shops Filter report data by shop(s) (multi-select) All, Single, Multiple All Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No Outlets Filter report data by outlet(s) under the selected shop(s) (multi-select) All, Single, Multiple All Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No Grouping Select how item data is grouped (single-select); Categories = group item data by categories; Departments/No Grouping = group item data by departments No Grouping, Categories, Departments QA没有标准,请PO提供方案 - Sub-Grouping Filter the sub-types under the selected grouping, supports sub-categories/sub-departments (multi-select); Remark: sub-grouping is not sorted in order (HERO-48211) All, Single, Multiple All - Display Range Select the data display range (single-select); By Outlet = display data grouping by outlet; By Shop = display data grouping by shop By Outlet, By Shop By Outlet - Including Discounts Whether to include discounts in item sales (single-select); Yes = display item net sales data; No = display item gross sales data Yes, No No - Including Tax Whether to include add-on tax in item sales data (single-select); Yes = add the add-on tax to item sales data; No = not add the add-on tax Yes, No No - Data Fields to Validate Fields Name Fields Description Field Calculation Platform Setting/Notes Report Title Show corresponding report title by selection; report name shows 'Sales Report (By Category, Incl./Excl. Discounts, Incl./Excl. Tax)' according to Including Discounts and Including Tax; shop name shows only when a single shop is selected, otherwise hidden; outlet name shows only when a single outlet is selected, otherwise hidden - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No Month Show the corresponding month(s) the user chose; Current Month/Last Month show the selected month and the next three months (format: Month-Year, e.g. February-25); Specific Month displays up to 4 months counting from the beginning month (e.g. begin 2024-09-30 to end 2025-05-15 displays September to December); header format e.g. (2025-02) - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Date Format, Default Date Format: CCYY-MM-DD; Time Format, Default Time Format: 24-hour clock Shops Show the specified shop name; only shows up when Display Range = 'By Shop' - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No Outlets Show the specified outlet name; only shows up when Display Range = 'By Outlet' - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No Groupings Show the corresponding categories name when Grouping = 'Categories'; show the corresponding departments name when Grouping = 'No Grouping' or 'Departments'; if an item is not set department or category, show "Undefined" - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Department Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit Amount Show item sales total for the corresponding month by the selected grouping; Including Discounts = Yes shows item net sales total, No shows item gross sales total; Including Tax = Yes adds the add-on tax total to item sales data, No does not add it Parent department/category sales data = parent department/category sales data + child department/category sales data Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Revenue % Show the amount divided by the total amount in the month as Revenue % Revenue % = Amount / Total Amount in the month - Total Show Amount total and Revenue % total per outlet/shop and the grand total row - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . Printed At Time Show running report date and time; the format follows the setup - Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Date Format, Default Date Format: CCYY-MM-DD; Time Format, Default Time Format: 24-hour clock Printed By User Show running report user last name and first name - - Report Code Show report code "POS220" in report and export; System Management > System Configuration > Report Module > Show Footer Report Code: Yes = show; No = hide - Notes: System Management > System Configuration > Report Module > Show Footer Report Code: Yes = show; No = hide P. Show the page number - - Requirements Traceability Fix Version JIRA Ticket V1.2.98.0 HERO-51272 V1.2.96.0 HERO-50896 V1.2.94.0 HERO-49583 V1.2.92.0 HERO-46957 V1.2.61.0 HERO-25654 V1.2.50.0 HERO-19179

knowledge_base.content: CUS346 - Revenue Summary Report (By Date)(Without Header And Footer) Report Information Field Value Name Revenue Summary Report (By Date)(Without Header And Footer) Code CUS346 Parameters to Validate Parameters Name Description Options Default Date Type Business day selection for the report. Current Business Day = display current business data; Last Business Day = display last business data; Current Month = display current month; Last Month = display last month; Specified as Below = display specified as below data. (single-select). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Query Configuration: Maximum Query Days, Default: Empty, No Limit Current Business Day, Last Business Day, Current Month, Last Month, Specified as Below Current Business Day Shops Shop(s) included in the report; supports selecting all / a single / multiple shops. All = display all shops data. (multi-select). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No All, Single, Multiple All Outlets Outlet(s) included in the report; supports selecting all / a single / multiple outlets. All = display all outlets data. (multi-select). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Show Shop Short Name = Yes/No, Default: No All, Single, Multiple All Revenue / Non-Revenue Revenue scope of the report. All revenue = display all revenue data; Revenue = display revenue data; Non-Revenue = display non-revenue data; Advance Order = display advance order data. (single-select) All, Revenue, Non-Revenue, Advance Order All Show SC Whether to show SC (service charge) section. Select show SC = display all SC data; not select show SC = not display all SC data. (single-select) Yes, No Yes Show TAX Whether to show TAX section. Select show TAX = display all TAX data; not select show TAX = not display all TAX data. (single-select) Yes, No Yes Show DISCOUNT Whether to show DISCOUNT section. Select show DISCOUNT = display all DISCOUNT data; not select show DISCOUNT = not display all DISCOUNT data. (single-select) Yes, No Yes Show ROUNDING Whether to show ROUNDING section. Select show ROUNDING = display all ROUNDING data; not select show ROUNDING = not display all ROUNDING data. (single-select) Yes, No Yes Data Fields to Validate Fields Name Fields Description Field Calculation Data Shows business day. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Date Format, Default Date Format: CCYY-MM-DD; Time Format, Default Time Format: 24-hour clock - Outlet Code Shows outlet's code. - Outlet Description Shows outlet's name (follows language settings). - Department Code Shows department's code. - Department Description Shows department's name. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Department Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit - Sales Qty Shows department sales item quantity. - Net Amount Shows the totals of the department description row: departments, Service Charge, Tax, Check Discount, Rounding. Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Format Configuration: Rounding, Default Rounding: Round Off; Decimal Places, Default Decimal Places: 2; Currency Sign, Default Currency Sign: $; Thousand Separator, Default Thousand Separator: Empty; Decimal Separator, Default Decimal Separator: . - Payment Code Shows the code of the payment method (Revenue / Non-revenue / All / Advance order). - Payment Description Shows the name of the payment method (follows language settings). Settings: Go to Platform: System Management > System Configuration > Report > Mapping Configuration: Payment Mapping, Default: Empty, No Limit - Qty Shows the quantity of department items of the payment method. - ** End Of Report ** Reports do not have headers and footers. - Report Number Reports do not have headers and footers. - Printed At Time Reports do not have headers and footers. - Printed By User Reports do not have headers and footers. - Page Number Reports do not have headers and footers. - Requirements Traceability Fix Version JIRA Ticket 1.2.94.0 HERO-47187

requirement.summary: BYOD Module - Takeaway Box Settings shows the master item name and Invalid data for a listed shop
requirement.description:
Use Case:

BYOD admin in a sub config zone uses Takeaway Box Settings. The item name on the list does not match the name shown in Menu for that zone. Selecting a shop that is listed under Available in Locations shows Invalid data.

Steps to Reproduce:

Open Takeaway Box Settings in a sub config zone>Compare the item name with the same item in Menu>Select a shop under Available in Locations that belongs to an upper zone

Current Result:

The list and edit screen show the master item name, not the name configured for that zone [Unexpected]

Selecting that shop shows Error : Takeaway Box Settings / Invalid data [Unexpected]

Expected Result:

The list and edit screen show the same item name as Menu for that zone [Expected]

Selecting a shop that appears under Available in Locations opens the filtered list [Expected]

Root Cause [Optional]:

HERO-69086

The Takeaway Box Settings screen reads the item master name and does not apply the name set for the shop's config zone.

The location list includes shops from the current zone and from its parent and child zones, but the check only accepts shops that sit exactly on the current zone. A shop that is shown can therefore be rejected as invalid data.
